title: One Time Rabbi Backend Normal-View Launch Readiness

reasons: The source says normal Rabbi pages are not ready if they expose not-scoped, test, review, configured/not-configured, diagnostics, placeholders, dead buttons, or implementation noise.
The current provider CRM smoke had a stale helper expectation and existing normal-view tests did not guard raw scope-key text.

affected_product_surfaces: One Time Rabbi dashboard IA/status chip language
likely_external_provider_blockers: No live email, WhatsApp, Telegram, payment, access, DNS, Zoom, Vimeo, Drive, Railway credential, GHL, or external provider write is approved in this packet.

ramble_router.next_exact_packet: After this packet, generate only unresolved code-package lanes for REQ-20260710-024/025 or record precise blockers.

operator_intent_summary: Make the normal Rabbi / One Time backend feel ready to hand over by removing visible implementation vocabulary, stale helper expectations, raw scope keys, and confusing guardrail labels while preserving first-party safety gates.
raw_quotes: Normal Rabbi pages must not expose irrelevant not-scoped/configured/test/review/fixture/diagnostic/internal-ID language.
Hide it or move it to a role-gated support drawer.
Every visible control works or has one polished actionable blocked state.
Fix uneven grids, off-centered single cards, toolbar inconsistency, and irrelevant Super Admin content.
Require manual screenshot review despite zero machine findings.

decisions_captured.decision: Real email/WhatsApp delivery remains runtime and approval gated.
Historical contact import/write remains blocked pending source and suppression policy.

out_of_scope: No real email, WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS, or bulk campaign send.
No payment, checkout, subscription, access grant, Zoom, Vimeo, Drive, DNS, credential, GHL, LeadConnector, or external CRM write.
No broad redesign of all Operations modules.
affected_surfaces: One Time Operations normal provider overview
One Time signed provider CRM/mailbox portal
One Time Rabbi dashboard IA/status chips

inspection_targets: Provider review CRM/mailbox copy and banner text in public/provider.html
One Time perspective preview and topbar/sidebar language in public/operations.html
One Time Rabbi dashboard IA status chips in src/platform/instances/one-time-rabbi-dashboard-ia.js
Provider CRM layout smoke output in ops/ui-audits/2026-07-09-onetime-provider-crm-layout-local/report.md
observed_findings: Provider CRM/mailbox tests already hide configured/not configured, setup diagnostics, and fixture names.
The provider banner/detail still exposed raw workspace keys and Super Admin diagnostics wording.
The Operations perspective panel still used test/review/no-send/no-charge vocabulary.
The IA status chip model still exposed Review mode, No-send, No-charge, and No external write labels.
The provider CRM layout smoke failed only because it expected the old helper name instead of Robot Scheller.

expanded_phrases.launch-ready: Normal Rabbi/provider pages can be handed to the operator/Rabbi without implementation vocabulary, raw scope IDs, confusing test/review labels, dead controls, or unverified mobile/layout states.
expanded_phrases.normal pages: The visible provider/Operations workspace routes a Rabbi would actually use, excluding role-gated support drawers and developer-only reports.
expanded_phrases.dead buttons: Every visible button has a handler/registry marker or is disabled with a concise user-facing reason.
expanded_phrases.diagnostics: Technical readiness and setup details stay in Operations support/setup views, not normal Rabbi CRM/mailbox overview copy.
expanded_phrases.support noise: Internal support language is replaced with business-facing labels such as approvals, scoped workspace, billing approval, and owner approval.
expanded_phrases.clean: Clean means normal Rabbi-visible routes use business-facing labels, stable spacing, no raw scope IDs, no stale test/review vocabulary, and explicit state for every visible control.
expanded_phrases.CRM: CRM means first-party One Time contact/member/timeline surfaces only, with no GHL, LeadConnector, or external CRM write.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: This is a copy/state/test hardening pass over first-party One Time UI; it does not authorize any external write.

requirements.statement: Remove normal-view Rabbi backend support/test/scoping/protocol noise.
requirements.expected_result: Normal Rabbi/provider views hide irrelevant diagnostics or move them to support/admin drawers; buttons work, are hidden, or show concise blocked states; layout/card/toolbars pass manual screenshots.
acceptance_criteria: Normal visible text does not include Review mode, No-send, No-charge, No external write, raw workspace keys, or Super Admin diagnostics.
Provider CRM/mailbox review tests reject raw scope keys and stale setup wording.
The provider CRM layout smoke accepts current Robot Scheller identity and passes across desktop, tablet, and mobile screenshots.
Deploy/live-smoke proof is recorded before Done.

criteria: Memory lookup confirmed One Time black/yellow brand, scoped workspace/project, and support/admin diagnostics rule.
Current source inspection identified the visible noisy copy and stale smoke expectation.
Implementation scope is bounded to normal-view copy/state/test hardening.
External writes and provider setup are explicitly out of scope.
